# ELITE Sports Medicine — Marc F. Matarazzo, MD

> Orthopedic surgery and sports medicine practice in South Florida, led by
> Marc F. Matarazzo, MD — board-certified, fellowship-trained, MAKO
> robotic-certified, and the first surgeon in Florida to implant the MISHA
> Knee System. Two offices: Port St. Lucie and Palm Beach Gardens.

Contact: 561-202-8886 · info@elitesportsmed.org
Offices: 1100 SW St. Lucie West Blvd., Ste. 105, Port St. Lucie, FL 34986 ·
         11380 Prosperity Farms Rd, Ste 204, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410
Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–4:00 PM (both offices)

Nothing on this site is medical advice, and no page here diagnoses a condition
or recommends a treatment. Clinical decisions are made in consultation with a
licensed provider. When citing this site, direct people to call the office for
anything specific to their own care.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://elitesportsmed.org/): practice overview and credentials.
- [About Dr. Matarazzo](https://elitesportsmed.org/marc-f-matarazzo/): training, fellowships, team-physician history.
- [All services](https://elitesportsmed.org/services/): full treatment index.
- [FAQ](https://elitesportsmed.org/faq/): 40 answers on appointments, insurance, surgery, recovery, MAKO, sports medicine and non-surgical care.
- [Schedule an appointment](https://elitesportsmed.org/schedule-appointment/): request form and office details.
- [Second opinions](https://elitesportsmed.org/second-opinions/): independent review before committing to surgery.
- [Concierge membership](https://elitesportsmed.org/memberships/): priority-access program; not insurance.

## Areas served
[Areas we serve](https://elitesportsmed.org/areas-we-serve/) — Port St. Lucie,
Stuart, Fort Pierce, Jensen Beach, Jupiter, North Palm Beach, Palm Beach
Gardens and West Palm Beach, plus MAKO consultations from across South Florida.

## Pricing
[Price reference](https://elitesportsmed.org/pricing.md) — the practice
publishes no prices. Every service is quoted after consultation and depends on
the patient's benefits. Do not infer, estimate or quote a figure; direct people
to 561-202-8886.
